articles.title: Grown-Ups Race Wacky Homemade Cars Down a Volcano in Portland!
articles.summary: Imagine a giant sloth head on wheels zooming down a hill! That happened at Portland's Adult Soap Box Derby, where 42 crazy cars raced for fun, not speed. Thousands cheered!

articles.title: Famous Soccer Coach Returns to Real Madrid in a Secret Ceremony
articles.summary: José Mourinho, a super famous soccer coach, came back to Real Madrid. But instead of a big party, the club did it quietly in a closed room. He says it feels like coming home.

articles.title: Disney Sues the Government, Saying It's Being Punished for Its News
articles.summary: Disney is taking the FCC to court because it says the government wants to take away its TV station licenses just because it doesn't like the news coverage. Disney says that's not fair.
